description: Implementation of a connection manager for an AMQP client using Vert.x and Proton, handling connection lifecycle, reconnection logic, and link management for the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: HonoConnectionImpl
classes.description: Manages AMQP connection lifecycle, reconnection, and link creation for Eclipse Hono using Vert.x and Proton.

classes.name: ConnectMethodConnectionHandler
classes.description: Wrapper handler to invoke multiple connection handlers in sequence during connect.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Hono server, with optional ProtonClientOptions.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the server, with optional completion handler.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the client, closing connections.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an AMQP sender link to a target address with specified QoS and close hook.

methods.name: createReceiver
methods.description: Creates an AMQP receiver link for a source address with specified QoS, message handler, and remote close hook.

methods.name: getRemoteContainer
methods.description: Returns the remote container ID if connected.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer for message tracing.
